fusions.name: Five Good Shots
fusions.desc: Fires a jet of musk at the first enemy within 10 tiles that deals 9 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Both Barrels
fusions.desc: Discharges both glands with a bang across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 14 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Smoke Bank
fusions.desc: Lays a bank of foul powder smoke 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Bore and Choke
fusions.desc: Your poison damage cannot be resisted.
